messages:
Maya P.: Hey folks — launching a short verification sprint for the new handbook appendix on benefits eligibility. Target: manager sign-offs for edge cases and enrollment data reconciliation by EOD next Friday. :calendar:
Alex R.: Quick q — is this a rehash of last quarter's open-enrollment refresh or a new appendix?
Maya P.: New appendix. It specifically clarifies eligibility for contractors, permanent part-timers, and international hires. Draft here: https://redwood.intranet/handbook/appendix-benefits
Jon K.: Will loop in hiring managers. Do they need to upload supporting docs anywhere?
Maya P.: Managers should mark the verification sheet. Column to set: "manager_verified" = yes. If exception, tag "benefits-exception" and add note. Sheet: https://sheets.redwood.internal/benefits-verification-2026
Sasha L.: APAC question — some folks still on legacy regional plans. How should those be handled?
Maya P.: Mark rows with "legacy_plan" and include a short comment. We'll reconcile legacy cases in a follow-up audit.
Emily T.: Can ops export current enrollments as CSV for bulk checks?
People Ops Bot: Export available. Command to fetch latest CSV:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HR_API_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/hr/enrollments?format=csv -o enrollments_1735126789.csv
```
Alex R.: I'll pull it and attach to the sheet this afternoon. :white_check_mark:
Jon K.: Confirming timeline — managers get 7 business days after CSV posted to verify?
Maya P.: Correct. If not verified, defaults apply and HR will follow up.
Sasha L.: Can we get a short one-pager for managers covering the top 6 edge cases?
Maya P.: On it. Drafting a checklist with examples and a quick decision tree. Will share before the end of day.
Emily T.: How are we tracking microtraining completion?
Maya P.: Module in LMS: "Benefits Appendix — Eligibility clarifier (10 min)". Managers should confirm completions in the sheet; LMS will emit completion events to our tracking webhook.
People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled for 1735126845 to nudge managers who haven't completed verification.
Alex R.: I'll ping my managers in their channels too.
Maya P.: Action summary: (1) Ops: export + attach CSV; (2) Managers: review sheet and mark manager_verified within 7 business days; (3) Everyone: complete LMS module; (4) People Ops: publish one-pager and reconcile legacy_plan rows. For ambiguous cases, open a ticket with tag "benefits-exception".
Jon K.: Should exceptions be DMed or raised as tickets?
Maya P.: Tickets only — creates an audit trail. Use template: https://redwood.intranet/ops/tickets/benefits-exception-template
Sasha L.: Happy to help triage legacy APAC rows.
People Ops Bot: Acknowledged.
Maya P.: Thanks all — will post final appendix and checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:
